items.question: How does this compare to DreamoAI?
items.answer: Both tools use AI to generate dance videos. The main difference is our web-based approach — no app download needed. We also offer pre-made dance templates for faster creation, while DreamoAI may offer different features through their app.

items.question: Do I need to download anything?
items.answer: No. Our AI dance generator runs entirely in your browser. Just visit the website, upload a photo, and start generating. Works on any device with a modern browser.

items.question: Is the video quality comparable?
items.answer: Yes. We use advanced AI models (including Kling AI) to generate high-quality dance videos. Output is 720p HD in vertical 9:16 format, optimized for social media.

items.question: Can I try it before paying?
items.answer: Absolutely. Sign up for free and receive starter credits. No credit card required. You can generate multiple dance videos to test the quality before purchasing additional credits.

items.question: What if I need a dance style you don't have?
items.answer: We add new templates weekly based on trending content and user requests. If you need a specific dance style, let us know and we'll prioritize adding it.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Uploaded photos are used only for generation and are not stored permanently. We don't use your photos for training or share them with third parties.
